definitions.gloss: scholarship, academic learning, science and arts
definitions.explanation: Systematic study, research, and the body of knowledge produced by academic institutions. Used as a modifier to indicate that something is scholarly or academic in nature.

examples.japanese: {学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
{学術|がくじゅつ}{的|てき}な⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: It is based on academic research.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おり、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}いている→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: This university focuses on international academic exchange and actively invites researchers from abroad.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a modifier before another noun: {学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧ (academic paper), {学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (academic conference), {学術|がくじゅつ}{書|しょ} (scholarly book). The derived form {学術|がくじゅつ}{的|てき} (academic, scholarly) is also frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: academic paper
- {学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: academic conference
- {学術|がくじゅつ}{的|てき}: academic, scholarly
- {学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧: academic exchange
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{学術|がくじゅつ}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: Science Council of Japan
